steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic and cut the chicken into 1 cm pieces.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, about 8 minutes, until it bubbles hard.
Cook the wheat pasta in the boiling water 1 minute less than the package says, until just tender. Drain, keeping 125 ml of the water.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, about 1 minute, until it shimmers.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes, stirring, until soft and translucent. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook 5 to 6 minutes, stirring, until no pink remains.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and the salt. Simmer 8 minutes, until the sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in the heavy cream and the drained pasta; add pasta water a spoon at a time until the sauce coats every piece.
Cool to lukewarm. Under 12 months, chop the pasta and chicken small. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
